body.summary: Completed GitHub mesh self-hosting as a sanitized WorkGraph/EvidenceGraph transport projection. The epoch imported and materially consumed a valid external transport event, exposed three real race/integrity gaps, fixed them, and exported a bounded TraceDivergence plus receipt summary. Both local envelopes bind their declared SHA-256 addresses, pass the privacy gate, and exist on run8-mesh with exact readback. Invalid or rebound external bytes remain quarantined and unacknowledged; no GitHub issue/comment workflow or authority inference was introduced.
